AfterGoldGained.issue: Closed 2026-07-29 (round 7): `Relic.after_gold_gained(run, amount)` is a real base hook and DragonFruit implements it (DragonFruit.cs:22-29, MaxHpVar(1)). Both details the entry demanded are in `RunState.gain_gold`: the dispatch is AFTER `self.gold += gained` (PlayerCmd.cs:168-169), so a listener reads the new balance, and it is INSIDE the `if amount > 0` arm, which is PlayerCmd.cs:146-149's bail tested on the amount AFTER ModifyGoldGained -- so a player holding Ectoplasm gets no Max HP, an anti-synergy rather than a combo. All three are pinned separately in test/test_false_premise_stubs.py.  The stub's premise was checked before the code (PROMPT.md bug class 12) and was false, which is the fifth round running that has held.   NOT CLOSED: nothing at this site; no other relic implements the new hook.  The text it replaced read: Carries guard G1's LIVE label: +1 Max HP per gold gain never happens.
